name: Mobile App Release
description: Intake to live for the App Store, Google Play, a website and an API: fix loop, full regression, your go/no-go with proof, store review watched for you.
goal: Ship {release_label} on {platform_words}, with proof before anything reaches a store.
title: Release {release_label}

parameters.label: Version
parameters.help: The marketing version on iOS, the website and the API.

parameters.label: Android version
parameters.help: Leave empty to use the same version as iOS.

parameters.label: What's in this release
parameters.placeholder: Broker fee shows as a percentage; faster listing photos

parameters.label: Scenario tags for the changed screens
Coverage warning below
parameters.help: Validated scenarios a platform needs before the proof stops warning.

parameters.label: App Store status command
parameters.help: Run from the project root without a shell: ~ and $VARS are not expanded, so use absolute paths.

parameters.label: Release inventory command
parameters.help: Fills the Release home: what's live, in review, merged since the last release, and the next versions. Same rules: no shell, absolute paths.

parameters.label: Google Play status command
parameters.help: Run from the project root without a shell: ~ and $VARS are not expanded, so use absolute paths.

steps.title: Collect the feedback batch
steps.description: List the issues and feature requests that make up this release. One build per round, never one per fix.
steps.definition_of_done: The batch is written down and agreed: {batch_summary}

steps.title: Release readiness baseline
steps.description: Run the project's readiness scripts (store status, signing, metadata) and post what is missing.
steps.definition_of_done: A readiness note lists every gap, or says there is none.

steps.title: Fix or build each batch item
steps.description: Test-first, one small PR per batch item, against origin/main in a worktree. In a later round, fix what the QA triage found.
steps.definition_of_done: Every batch item has an open PR with tests; the PR links are posted.

steps.title: Review and merge
steps.description: Review the diffs and merge. Agents never merge on their own. To ask for changes, comment on the PR; the engineer updates it, and you mark this step once it's merged.
steps.definition_of_done: Every PR of this round is merged.

steps.title: Deploy the API to staging
steps.description: Deploy to {qa_target_env}, then prove the change is live there: fetch an endpoint the change touched. A script's exit code is not proof.
steps.definition_of_done: The changed endpoint answers on {qa_target_env} with the new behaviour (request and response posted).

steps.title: Deploy the website to staging
steps.description: Deploy to {qa_target_env}, then prove it is live: load a changed page and check the new content. The deploy script can report success without uploading.
steps.definition_of_done: A changed page on {qa_target_env} shows the new content (URL and screenshot posted).

steps.title: Check the changed screens on iOS
steps.description: Only the scenarios for the screens this batch changed, plus every open finding, on iOS. Uses the scenario tags {qa_subset_tags} when set. Runs on a debug build pointed at {qa_target_env}.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: The screens changed in this batch: {batch_summary}

dry_run.note: Round 1 finds the fee shown as an amount; the fix passes in round 2.

steps.title: Check the changed screens on Android
steps.description: Only the scenarios for the screens this batch changed, plus every open finding, on Android. Uses the scenario tags {qa_subset_tags} when set. Runs on a debug build pointed at {qa_target_env}.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: The screens changed in this batch: {batch_summary}

dry_run.note: Round 1 finds the fee shown as an amount; the fix passes in round 2.

steps.title: Check the changed screens on Web
steps.description: Only the scenarios for the screens this batch changed, plus every open finding, on Web. Uses the scenario tags {qa_subset_tags} when set. Runs on a debug build pointed at {qa_target_env}.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: The screens changed in this batch: {batch_summary}

dry_run.note: Round 1 finds the fee shown as an amount; the fix passes in round 2.

steps.title: Triage what failed
steps.description: Sort every failure: a real bug to fix, a flaky check, or a scenario to update. Fixes go back to Build.
steps.definition_of_done: Every failure has a diagnosis; real bugs are findings with steps to reproduce.

steps.title: Draft the missing scenarios
steps.description: Each user-facing change in the batch needs a validated scenario. Draft the missing ones for the owner to approve. Warns below {coverage_threshold} scenarios a platform.
steps.definition_of_done: Every change in the batch maps to a scenario, drafted or validated.

qa.focus: Scenarios for the changes in this batch: {batch_summary}

steps.title: Approve the new scenarios
steps.description: Approve or reject the drafted scenarios in Quality. Coverage per platform is on the gate card before you decide.
steps.definition_of_done: The drafts are approved or rejected.

steps.title: Version {release_label}
steps.description: Set the versions for this release: {versions_detail}. Build numbers and versionCodes only go up. Open a PR. In a later round, fix what the regression found first, merge, and redeploy staging.
steps.definition_of_done: {versions_detail} is merged on main; the commit SHA is posted.

steps.title: Build the QA builds
steps.description: Debug builds of that commit pointed at {qa_target_env} (release builds block screenshots; iOS needs signing on so the login token can be saved). Record each build's identity for the QA steps.
steps.definition_of_done: A debug build per platform is installed on the QA devices; type, version, build, commit and environment are posted.

steps.title: Full regression on iOS
steps.description: Every validated iOS scenario, shared ones included, on the exact commit being released (a debug build of it pointed at {qa_target_env}; release builds block screenshots). Paused and suspicious scenarios are listed as skipped, never silently dropped.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: Full regression: every validated scenario for this platform.

steps.title: Full regression on Android
steps.description: Every validated Android scenario, shared ones included, on the exact commit being released (a debug build of it pointed at {qa_target_env}; release builds block screenshots). Paused and suspicious scenarios are listed as skipped, never silently dropped.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: Full regression: every validated scenario for this platform.

steps.title: Full regression on Web
steps.description: Every validated Web scenario, shared ones included, on the exact commit being released (a debug build of it pointed at {qa_target_env}; release builds block screenshots). Paused and suspicious scenarios are listed as skipped, never silently dropped.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: Full regression: every validated scenario for this platform.

steps.title: Triage the regression
steps.description: Sort every regression failure. Real bugs go back to the version step for a fix and a new build.
steps.definition_of_done: Every failure has a diagnosis.

steps.title: Archive, scan and upload iOS
steps.description: Archive and export {version} ({build}) from the commit that passed regression, run the project's pre-upload scans, and upload to App Store Connect.
steps.definition_of_done: The upload is accepted; the scans' output is posted.

steps.title: Wait for build processing
steps.description: Watches App Store Connect until build {build} is VALID (usually 5 to 15 minutes).
steps.definition_of_done: Build {build} is VALID.

steps.title: Build and upload to internal
steps.description: Build the signed AAB for {android_version} (versionCode {android_version_code}) and upload to the internal track: a dry run first, then for real.
steps.definition_of_done: versionCode {android_version_code} is on the internal track.

steps.title: Test the build yourself
steps.description: Install from TestFlight and the internal track, and try it on real devices (iPhone, iPad, App Clip, Android phone).
steps.definition_of_done: You tried the release build on your devices.

steps.title: Your go-ahead
steps.description: The proof pack: per-platform counts, every failure with its reason, screenshots of the changed screens, coverage, what only unit tests checked. Nothing reaches a store before you say Go here. A standing 'submit when green' is not accepted.
steps.definition_of_done: You chose Go, No-go or Send back, with a reason for the last two.

steps.title: Submit for App Review
steps.description: Attach build {build} to version {version}, set the release type to {release_type} (the one you chose for this version), and submit.
steps.definition_of_done: Version {version} is Waiting for Review with build {build}.

steps.title: Promote to production
steps.description: Promote the same versionCode {android_version_code} ({android_version}) to production at {android_rollout} rollout: a dry run, then for real. Managed publishing is off, so an approved update goes live on its own.
steps.definition_of_done: versionCode {android_version_code} is in production review at {android_rollout}.

steps.title: Deploy the API to production
steps.description: Production deploy, after staging. Then prove the change is live in production: fetch a changed endpoint.
steps.definition_of_done: The changed endpoint answers in production with the new behaviour.

steps.title: Deploy the website to production
steps.description: Production deploy, after staging. Then prove it is live: load a changed page.
steps.definition_of_done: A changed page in production shows the new content.

steps.title: App Store review
steps.description: Watches App Review: waiting, in review, then approved or rejected. Approved is not live yet: a manual release waits for you, an automatic one for the App Store.
steps.definition_of_done: Version {version} is approved, or you decided what a rejection means.

steps.title: Google Play review
steps.description: Watches the production track. Google Play's API can't say when an update is live, so after review it reports unknown: then you confirm it in Play Console.
steps.definition_of_done: versionCode {android_version_code} is live.

watch.owner_hint: Google Play's API can't say whether versionCode {android_version_code} is live. Only you can confirm it: check Play Console.

steps.title: Fix what App Review rejected
steps.description: Read the rejection in App Store Connect and fix it: code in a small PR with tests, or the metadata. Post what changed and why it answers the reviewer.
steps.definition_of_done: The fix is in an open PR (or the metadata is updated), with the rejection reason quoted.

steps.title: Review and merge the fix
steps.description: Review the fix and merge it. For a metadata-only fix, say so.
steps.definition_of_done: The fix is merged, or it was metadata only.

steps.title: New iOS build and upload
steps.description: Bump the iOS build number past {build}, archive {version} from the merged commit, run the pre-upload scans and upload. Post the new build number.
steps.definition_of_done: The new build is uploaded; its build number and the scans' output are posted.

steps.title: Wait for the new build to process
steps.description: Watches App Store Connect until the newest build of {version} is VALID.
steps.definition_of_done: The new build is VALID.

steps.title: Check the fix on iOS
steps.description: The screens the fix touched, plus every open finding, on a debug build of the merged commit pointed at {qa_target_env}.
steps.definition_of_done: Every scenario in scope has a verdict with screenshots; the build under test (type, version, build, commit, environment) is recorded on the result.

qa.focus: The fix for the App Review rejection and the screens it touched.

steps.title: Your go-ahead to resubmit
steps.description: The proof for the fixed build. Nothing goes back to App Review before you say Go here.
steps.definition_of_done: You chose Go or No-go, with a reason for No-go.

steps.title: Resubmit for App Review
steps.description: Attach the new build to version {version}, answer the reviewer in Resolution Center, keep the release type {release_type}, and submit.
steps.definition_of_done: Version {version} is Waiting for Review with the new build.

steps.title: App Store review, again
steps.description: Watches App Review for the resubmitted build.
steps.definition_of_done: Version {version} is approved, or you decided what a new rejection means.

steps.title: Release it on the App Store
steps.description: Version {version} is approved and waits for you (manual release). Release it in App Store Connect when you're ready, then say so here.
steps.definition_of_done: You pressed Release in App Store Connect.

steps.title: Check it's live on the App Store
steps.description: Watches until version {version} is Ready for Sale.
steps.definition_of_done: Version {version} is Ready for Sale.

steps.title: Check what is live
steps.description: Confirm the live versions in each store and in production, and run a short smoke check of the live build.
steps.definition_of_done: The live versions are posted with a smoke-check result.

steps.title: Release notes and history
steps.description: Record the release: versions, build ids, QA run links, decision times. Clean up worktrees, branches and test tokens.
steps.definition_of_done: The release history is written and the clean-up is done.
